These are my working notes for William Feller's *An Introduction to Probability Theory and Its Applications* [@feller1968]. Each chapter page has conceptual notes followed by a problem set. Finance-motivated problems (marked in blue) connect the classical theory to derivatives pricing, portfolio risk, and market microstructure.
